description: Defines classes and functions related to frames per second (FPS) measurements, ranges, and comparisons for Android surfaceflinger scheduler.

classes.name: Fps
classes.description: Represents frames per second as a floating-point frequency, with methods for conversion and comparison.

classes.name: FpsRange
classes.description: Represents a range of FPS values with minimum and maximum bounds.

classes.name: FpsRanges
classes.description: Contains physical and render FPS ranges, representing display and render rates.

classes.name: FpsApproxEqual
classes.description: Functor for approximate equality comparison of Fps objects.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Creates an Fps object from a float frequency value.

methods.name: fromPeriodNsecs
methods.description: Creates an Fps object from a period in nanoseconds.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the Fps object has a valid (positive) frequency.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the FPS as a float.

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Returns the FPS as an integer, rounded.

methods.name: getPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period as a Period object.

methods.name: getPeriodNsecs
methods.description: Returns the period in nanoseconds.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if an FPS value or range is within the range.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the FPS ranges are valid.

methods.name: operator""_Hz
methods.description: User-defined literal to create Fps from Hz.

methods.name: isStrictlyLess
methods.description: Checks if one Fps is strictly less than another.

methods.name: isApproxEqual
methods.description: Checks if two Fps are approximately equal.

methods.name: isApproxLess
methods.description: Checks if one Fps is approximately less than another.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for Fps, FpsRange, and FpsRanges.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for Fps, FpsRange, and FpsRanges.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison for Fps.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Greater-than comparison for Fps.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Less-than-or-equal comparison for Fps.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Greater-than-or-equal comparison for Fps.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Divides one Fps by another or by an unsigned divisor.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts Fps, FpsRange, or FpsRanges to string representation.
